name: Free City of Danzig (1920–1939)
description: A red field charged with a golden crown above two white crosses in pale.
history: Flag of the Free City of Danzig, the League of Nations city-state (1920–1939) whose seizure by Germany opened the Second World War. The crown-and-crosses arms have marked Danzig/Gdańsk since the 15th century.

features.role: two couped white crosses in vertical arrangement
